latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Trimmer In Between – Cut and Rejoin Video Sections.

- Upload video clips (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM) and request removal of specific sections by timestamp.
- Quickly trim and rejoin video segments without sliders, getting a smooth joined 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- All editing and rendering handled by remote GPU nodes; download the result in seconds.
- Supports credit system, error handling, and workflow guidance for efficient editing.
- Provides clear workflows for single, batch, and iterative trimming needs.
